What this part coversApa yang bahagian ini liputi

Plane Stress Part 1 gave the PDE in u and v, the boundary conditions and the 2 × 8 matrix [N]; this part turns them into numbers, exactly as Heat Transfer Part 2 did for temperature. Galerkin and integration by parts give [k]{û}ᵀ = {q} + {b}; the strain–displacement matrix [B] = [∂]ᵀ[N] puts [k] in the form t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA, whose 64 entries reduce to twelve closed-form values for a rectangle. Edge tractions and self-weight become nodal loads, the elements are assembled through the dof map, the fixed edge is struck, and the text’s cantilever is solved and judged against beam theory and a refined mesh.Plane Stress Part 1 memberi PDE dalam u dan v, boundary condition dan matrix 2 × 8 [N]; bahagian ini menukarkannya kepada nombor, sama seperti Heat Transfer Part 2 lakukan untuk temperature. Galerkin dan integration by parts memberi [k]{û}ᵀ = {q} + {b}; strain–displacement matrix [B] = [∂]ᵀ[N] meletakkan [k] dalam bentuk t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA, dan 64 entrinya menjadi dua belas nilai closed-form bagi segi empat tepat. Traction tepi dan self-weight menjadi nodal load, element di-assemble melalui dof map, tepi yang fixed dibuang, dan cantilever dalam teks diselesaikan serta dinilai berbanding beam theory dan mesh yang di-refine.

After this part you should be able toSelepas bahagian ini, anda sepatutnya boleh

  1. Apply Galerkin and integration by parts to the plane-stress PDE, identify [k], {q} and {b}, and write [B] = [∂]ᵀ[N] and [k] = t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA.Menggunakan Galerkin dan integration by parts pada PDE plane stress, mengenal pasti [k], {q} dan {b}, dan menulis [B] = [∂]ᵀ[N] serta [k] = t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA.
  2. Evaluate the 8 × 8 stiffness matrix of a four-node rectangular element from the closed-form entries s1…s12, and check it.Menilai stiffness matrix 8 × 8 bagi four-node rectangular element daripada entri closed-form s1…s12, dan menyemaknya.
  3. Convert edge tractions and body forces into equivalent nodal loads, assemble the global system with two dofs per node and impose displacement conditions.Menukar traction tepi dan body force kepada nodal load yang setara, meng-assemble sistem global dengan dua dof setiap node dan mengenakan displacement condition.
  4. Solve the 2 × 2 cantilever, check its reactions, compare it with beam theory and a refined mesh, and explain why the coarse mesh is too stiff.Menyelesaikan cantilever 2 × 2, menyemak reaction-nya, membandingkannya dengan beam theory dan mesh yang di-refine, dan menerangkan mengapa mesh kasar terlalu stiff.

1. Galerkin and integration by parts, two unknowns per nodeGalerkin dan integration by parts, dua unknown setiap node

≈ 8 min

Plane Stress Part 1 ended with two results: the PDE [∂][E][∂]ᵀ{u}ᵀ = −{f} and the interpolation {u}ᵀ = [N]{û}ᵀ with the 2 × 8 matrix [N]. Substitute the second into the first and, as in Heat Transfer Part 2, it does not balance: a bilinear displacement field cannot satisfy two second-order equations at every point.Plane Stress Part 1 berakhir dengan dua hasil: PDE [∂][E][∂]ᵀ{u}ᵀ = −{f} dan interpolation {u}ᵀ = [N]{û}ᵀ dengan matrix 2 × 8 [N]. Gantikan yang kedua ke dalam yang pertama dan, seperti dalam Heat Transfer Part 2, ia tidak seimbang: displacement field bilinear tidak mampu memenuhi dua persamaan peringkat kedua pada setiap titik.

(3.31)
Galerkin, vector versionGalerkin, versi vectorWeight the residual with [N]ᵀ, the transpose of the interpolation matrix, and ask that each weighted average be zero. [N]ᵀ is 8 × 2, so one element gives eight equations, one per degree of freedom: u1, v1, …, u4, v4.Weight residual itu dengan [N]ᵀ, iaitu transpose matrix interpolation, dan minta supaya setiap purata ber-weight itu sifar. [N]ᵀ ialah 8 × 2, jadi satu element memberi lapan persamaan, satu setiap degree of freedom: u1, v1, …, u4, v4.
(3.32)

Integration by parts, then name the termsIntegration by parts, kemudian namakan term

Exactly as for heat, one [∂] moves from the displacements onto the weight [N]ᵀ (Green’s theorem, applied to each row). The derivative order falls to one, so a bilinear field is admissible, and a boundary integral appears that carries the traction, the natural condition of Plane Stress Part 1.Sama seperti haba, satu [∂] berpindah daripada displacement kepada weight [N]ᵀ (teorem Green, digunakan pada setiap baris). Peringkat derivative turun kepada satu, jadi field bilinear boleh diterima, dan satu integral sempadan muncul yang membawa traction, iaitu natural condition dalam Plane Stress Part 1.

(3.34)–(3.38)
(3.38)
TermTermNameNamaWhat it holdsApa yang dikandunginyaHeat analogueAnalog haba
[k]stiffness matrixmaterial, geometry and thickness of the element; symmetric; 8 × 8bahan, geometri dan ketebalan element; simetri; 8 × 8conductance matrix, 4 × 4conductance matrix, 4 × 4
{q}body-force vectorbody-force vectorforces per unit volume inside the element (self-weight), shared among its nodesdaya per unit isi padu di dalam element (self-weight), dikongsi antara node-nyasource vectorsource vector
{b}traction vectortraction vectorforces on edges with a known traction; zero on free edges; discarded with the equation on fixed edgesdaya pada tepi dengan traction diketahui; sifar pada tepi bebas; dibuang bersama persamaan pada tepi fixedboundary-flux vectorboundary-flux vector
Which edges of the cantilever contribute to {b}?Tepi cantilever mana yang menyumbang kepada {b}?Only the free end, x = 4 m, with its downward traction. The top and bottom edges are free (bx = by = 0), so their boundary term vanishes. On the fixed edge the traction is unknown, but it multiplies the shape functions of nodes whose equations are struck when u = v = 0 is imposed; it comes back afterwards as the support reactions, just as the heat flow did at a prescribed temperature.Hanya hujung bebas, x = 4 m, dengan traction ke bawah. Tepi atas dan bawah bebas (bx = by = 0), jadi boundary term-nya lenyap. Pada tepi fixed traction tidak diketahui, tetapi ia mendarab shape function bagi node yang persamaannya dibuang apabila u = v = 0 dikenakan; ia kembali kemudian sebagai support reaction, sama seperti aliran haba pada temperature yang ditetapkan.
Key pointsPerkara utama
  • Weight the residual with [N]ᵀ: eight equations per four-node element.Weight residual dengan [N]ᵀ: lapan persamaan setiap four-node element.
  • Integration by parts lowers the derivative order and exposes the traction as the natural condition.Integration by parts merendahkan peringkat derivative dan mendedahkan traction sebagai natural condition.
  • [k]{û}ᵀ = {q} + {b} = {r}: stiffness, body force, traction; the same structure as heat with two unknowns per node.[k]{û}ᵀ = {q} + {b} = {r}: stiffness, body force, traction; struktur yang sama seperti haba dengan dua unknown setiap node.
Quick check · not gradedSemak cepat · tidak bergred

Weighting the plane-stress residual with [N]ᵀ gives, for one four-node element,Weight residual plane stress dengan [N]ᵀ memberi, bagi satu four-node element,

[N]ᵀ is 8 × 2 and the residual is 2 × 1, so the weighted residual is an 8 × 1 vector: one equation for each of u1, v1, …, u4, v4. Heat transfer gave four, one per node, because it had one unknown per node.[N]ᵀ ialah 8 × 2 dan residual ialah 2 × 1, jadi weighted residual ialah vector 8 × 1: satu persamaan bagi setiap u1, v1, …, u4, v4. Heat transfer memberi empat, satu setiap node, kerana ia ada satu unknown setiap node.

2. The strain–displacement matrix [B] and the stiffness matrixStrain–displacement matrix [B] dan stiffness matrix

≈ 9 min

In heat transfer the 2 × 4 matrix {∂}ᵀ{N} turned the nodal temperatures into the gradient. Its plane-stress counterpart turns the eight nodal displacements into the three strains, and it has a name of its own: the strain–displacement matrix [B].Dalam heat transfer, matrix 2 × 4 {∂}ᵀ{N} menukar nodal temperature kepada gradient. Padanannya dalam plane stress menukar lapan nodal displacement kepada tiga strain, dan ia ada nama sendiri: strain–displacement matrix [B].

  • Row 1 (εxx = ∂u/∂x): ∂Ni/∂x under each ui, zero under each vi.Baris 1 (εxx = ∂u/∂x): ∂Ni/∂x di bawah setiap ui, sifar di bawah setiap vi.
  • Row 2 (εyy = ∂v/∂y): ∂Ni/∂y under each vi, zero under each ui.Baris 2 (εyy = ∂v/∂y): ∂Ni/∂y di bawah setiap vi, sifar di bawah setiap ui.
  • Row 3 (εxy = ∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x, the engineering shear strain): ∂Ni/∂y under ui and ∂Ni/∂x under vi.Baris 3 (εxy = ∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x, engineering shear strain): ∂Ni/∂y di bawah ui dan ∂Ni/∂x di bawah vi.
Nothing new is computedTiada yang baharu dikiraEvery entry of [B] is a shape-function derivative from Heat Transfer Part 1: ∂N1/∂x = −(b − y)/(ab) = (y − b)/(ab), and so on. [B] only arranges them so that u and v are differentiated together.Setiap entri [B] ialah derivative shape function daripada Heat Transfer Part 1: ∂N1/∂x = −(b − y)/(ab) = (y − b)/(ab), dan seterusnya. [B] hanya menyusunnya supaya u dan v dibezakan serentak.

Worked step · [B] at (1.5, 0.3) of a 2 m × 1 m element (Activity 1)Langkah bekerja · [B] pada (1.5, 0.3) bagi element 2 m × 1 m (Aktiviti 1)

The derivatives are those of the Heat Transfer Part 1 point: ∂Ni/∂x = {−0.35, 0.35, 0.15, −0.15} and ∂Ni/∂y = {−0.25, −0.75, 0.75, 0.25} m−1. Place them in the three rows:Derivative-nya ialah derivative titik Heat Transfer Part 1: ∂Ni/∂x = {−0.35, 0.35, 0.15, −0.15} dan ∂Ni/∂y = {−0.25, −0.75, 0.75, 0.25} m−1. Letakkannya dalam tiga baris:

Each row adds up to zero, and in row 3 the u-entries and the v-entries add up to zero separately. The reason is physical: a rigid translation (all ui equal, all vi equal) produces no strain. Keep this [B]; Plane Stress Part 3 multiplies it by the nodal displacements to get the stresses.Setiap baris berjumlah sifar, dan dalam baris 3 entri u dan entri v masing-masing berjumlah sifar. Sebabnya fizikal: translation tegar (semua ui sama, semua vi sama) tidak menghasilkan strain. Simpan [B] ini; Plane Stress Part 3 mendarabnya dengan nodal displacement untuk mendapatkan stress.

The element stiffness matrix in [B] formElement stiffness matrix dalam bentuk [B]

Integration by parts left the product [N]ᵀ[∂] on the left and [∂]ᵀ[N] on the right of [E]. Both are [B] (the left one transposed), so the stiffness matrix is the same [B] twice with the material between:Integration by parts meninggalkan hasil darab [N]ᵀ[∂] di kiri dan [∂]ᵀ[N] di kanan [E]. Kedua-duanya ialah [B] (yang kiri di-transpose), jadi stiffness matrix ialah [B] yang sama dua kali dengan bahan di antaranya:

  • Thickness. The integrals are per unit thickness; the element has thickness t, so every entry of [k] and every load is multiplied by t.Ketebalan. Integral itu per unit ketebalan; element mempunyai ketebalan t, jadi setiap entri [k] dan setiap load didarab dengan t.
  • Symmetry. [B]ᵀ[E][B] is symmetric whenever [E] is, and integration keeps it so: at most 36 distinct entries, and for a rectangle only twelve (§3).Simetri. [B]ᵀ[E][B] simetri apabila [E] simetri, dan integration mengekalkannya: paling banyak 36 entri berbeza, dan bagi segi empat tepat hanya dua belas (§3).
  • Meaning. kij is the force at dof i needed to give dof j a unit displacement with every other dof held: the stiffness influence coefficient of structural analysis.Maksud. kij ialah daya pada dof i yang diperlukan untuk memberi dof j satu unit displacement dengan setiap dof lain ditahan: stiffness influence coefficient dalam analisis struktur.

How software integrates [k]Bagaimana perisian meng-integrate [k]

Key pointsPerkara utama
  • [B] = [∂]ᵀ[N], 3 × 8: strains from nodal displacements; every row adds up to zero.[B] = [∂]ᵀ[N], 3 × 8: strain daripada nodal displacement; setiap baris berjumlah sifar.
  • [k] = t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA, 8 × 8, symmetric; kij = force at i per unit displacement at j.[k] = t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA, 8 × 8, simetri; kij = daya pada i per unit displacement pada j.
  • Software integrates at 2 × 2 Gauss points; for a rectangle that is exact.Perisian meng-integrate pada 2 × 2 Gauss point; bagi segi empat tepat ia tepat.
Quick check · not gradedSemak cepat · tidak bergred

Why must every row of [B] add up to zero?Mengapa setiap baris [B] mesti berjumlah sifar?

Giving every node the same u (or the same v) moves the element without deforming it, so [B]{û}ᵀ must be zero; that is a sum of the u-entries (or the v-entries) of each row. [B] is 3 × 8 and cannot be symmetric; the Kronecker property is true but is not the reason.Memberi setiap node u yang sama (atau v yang sama) menggerakkan element tanpa mengubah bentuknya, jadi [B]{û}ᵀ mesti sifar; itu ialah jumlah entri u (atau entri v) bagi setiap baris. [B] ialah 3 × 8 dan tidak boleh simetri; sifat Kronecker itu benar tetapi bukan sebabnya.

3. The 8 × 8 stiffness matrix and its twelve valuesStiffness matrix 8 × 8 dan dua belas nilainya

≈ 11 min

One entry in full is enough to see how all of them are made. Take k34: row 3 belongs to u2 and column 4 to v2, so it couples the horizontal and the vertical displacement of the same node.Satu entri secara penuh sudah cukup untuk melihat bagaimana semuanya dibina. Ambil k34: baris 3 milik u2 dan lajur 4 milik v2, jadi ia menggandingkan displacement mendatar dan menegak bagi node yang sama.

k₃₄ in three steps (text (3.39)–(3.41))k₃₄ dalam tiga langkah (teks (3.39)–(3.41))

(3.39)
(3.40)
(3.41)

The integral of −x(b − y)/(a²b²) over the rectangle is −1/4, so k34 does not depend on a or b: the coupling between u and v at a node is the same for every rectangle. The text writes the result as Et/(8(ν − 1)).Integral −x(b − y)/(a²b²) atas segi empat tepat ialah −1/4, jadi k34 tidak bergantung pada a atau b: gandingan antara u dan v pada satu node adalah sama bagi setiap segi empat tepat. Teks menulis hasilnya sebagai Et/(8(ν − 1)).

Twelve values, one patternDua belas nilai, satu pola

Repeating the integration for the other entries gives only twelve distinct values, arranged by the symmetry of the rectangle. Rows 1, 3, 5, 7 belong to u1…u4 and rows 2, 4, 6, 8 to v1…v4; k34 is s6. You do not memorise the pattern: you read it correctly from the text.Mengulang integration untuk entri lain hanya memberi dua belas nilai berbeza, disusun mengikut simetri segi empat tepat. Baris 1, 3, 5, 7 milik u1…u4 dan baris 2, 4, 6, 8 milik v1…v4; k34 ialah s6. Anda tidak perlu menghafal pola ini: anda membacanya dengan betul daripada teks.

(3.42)
How to read the twelve valuesCara membaca dua belas nilai itus1, s3, s5, s7 couple u with u: they are the heat conductance values with kx = Et/(1 − ν²) and ky = Gt (stretching along x, shearing along y). s9…s12 couple v with v, the same with a and b swapped. s2, s4, s6, s8 couple u with v and contain no a or b.s1, s3, s5, s7 menggandingkan u dengan u: ia nilai conductance haba dengan kx = Et/(1 − ν²) dan ky = Gt (regangan sepanjang x, shear sepanjang y). s9…s12 menggandingkan v dengan v, sama tetapi a dan b ditukar. s2, s4, s6, s8 menggandingkan u dengan v dan tidak mengandungi a atau b.

[k] of the cantilever element × 10⁶ N m−1, text (3.44); rows and columns in the dof order u1, v1, …, u4, v4.[k] element cantilever × 10⁶ N m−1, teks (3.44); baris dan lajur mengikut susunan dof u1, v1, …, u4, v4.

All four elements of the 2 × 2 mesh have the same a, b and material, so this one matrix serves the whole mesh. The entries ±0.003 (s4, s8) are small because 1 − 3ν = 0.01 for ν = 0.33.Keempat-empat element mesh 2 × 2 mempunyai a, b dan bahan yang sama, jadi satu matrix ini mencukupi untuk seluruh mesh. Entri ±0.003 (s4, s8) kecil kerana 1 − 3ν = 0.01 bagi ν = 0.33.

Checks on any [k] you computeSemakan pada mana-mana [k] yang anda kiraSymmetric. In every row the u-entries add up to zero and so do the v-entries: a rigid translation in x or in y needs no force. A rigid rotation also gives [k]{d} = {0}. These three zero-energy modes make [k], and an unsupported [K], singular until the supports prevent them.Simetri. Dalam setiap baris entri u berjumlah sifar dan begitu juga entri v: translation tegar dalam x atau y tidak memerlukan daya. Rotation tegar juga memberi [k]{d} = {0}. Tiga zero-energy mode ini menjadikan [k], dan [K] tanpa support, singular sehingga support menghalangnya.
The usual trapsPerangkap biasaPlane strain [E] used where plane stress is asked (or the reverse); a and b swapped between s1 and s9; a sign lost in s4 = −s8 or s6 = −s2. The row-sum check catches only the lost sign: the other two give a matrix that is wrong but still balanced, so settle Ē = E/(1 − ν²) and which side is a before computing anything.[E] plane strain digunakan apabila plane stress diminta (atau sebaliknya); a dan b tertukar antara s1 dan s9; tanda hilang dalam s4 = −s8 atau s6 = −s2. Semakan jumlah baris hanya menangkap tanda yang hilang: dua yang lain memberi matrix yang salah tetapi masih seimbang, jadi tetapkan Ē = E/(1 − ν²) dan sisi mana a sebelum mengira apa-apa.
Key pointsPerkara utama
  • Twelve values s1…s12 in the pattern (3.42); the u–v couplings do not depend on a or b.Dua belas nilai s1…s12 dalam pola (3.42); gandingan u–v tidak bergantung pada a atau b.
  • Cantilever element: k11 = s1 = 0.875 × 10⁶, s2 = 0.373 × 10⁶, s9 = 1.622 × 10⁶ N m−1.Element cantilever: k11 = s1 = 0.875 × 10⁶, s2 = 0.373 × 10⁶, s9 = 1.622 × 10⁶ N m−1.
  • u-entries and v-entries of every row sum to zero; three zero-energy modes.Entri u dan entri v setiap baris berjumlah sifar; tiga zero-energy mode.

For ν = 1/3, the entries s4 and s8 of a rectangle areBagi ν = 1/3, entri s4 dan s8 bagi segi empat tepat ialah

s8 = −s4 = Et(1 − 3ν)/(8(1 − ν²)), and 1 − 3ν = 0 at ν = 1/3. That is why the cantilever element (ν = 0.33) shows only ±0.003 × 10⁶ there.s8 = −s4 = Et(1 − 3ν)/(8(1 − ν²)), dan 1 − 3ν = 0 pada ν = 1/3. Sebab itulah element cantilever (ν = 0.33) hanya menunjukkan ±0.003 × 10⁶ di situ.

4. Loads: edge tractions and body forcesLoad: traction tepi dan body force

≈ 7 min

The load vector follows the same rule as in heat transfer, now in the plane-stress dof order: along an edge only the shape functions of its two nodes are non-zero, and along that edge they are the linear functions of a bar. A uniform load is therefore shared equally by the two nodes, in the direction it acts and nowhere else.Load vector mengikut peraturan yang sama seperti heat transfer, kini dalam susunan dof plane stress: di sepanjang satu tepi hanya shape function dua node-nya yang bukan sifar, dan di sepanjang tepi itu ia fungsi linear bar. Load yang seragam oleh itu dikongsi sama rata oleh dua node, dalam arah ia bertindak dan tidak di tempat lain.

(3.45)
Per length or per area?Per panjang atau per luas?The text gives qy = −5 kN m−1: a load per unit length of edge for the whole thickness. A traction in kN m−2 must be multiplied by t first. In (3.45) the t of the integral cancels the 1/t of qy/t, which is why the thickness disappears from the result.Teks memberi qy = −5 kN m−1: load per unit panjang tepi untuk seluruh ketebalan. Traction dalam kN m−2 mesti didarab dengan t dahulu. Dalam (3.45), t daripada integral membatalkan 1/t daripada qy/t, sebab itulah ketebalan hilang daripada hasilnya.

A linearly varying edge loadEdge load yang berubah secara linear

If the load per unit length varies from pi at one node to pj at the other, the node at the heavier end takes more. The shares are those of the bar element, and their total and their moment about either node are the two checks:Jika load per unit panjang berubah daripada pi pada satu node kepada pj pada node yang lain, node di hujung yang lebih berat menerima lebih. Bahagiannya sama seperti bar element, dan jumlahnya serta momennya terhadap mana-mana node ialah dua semakan:

Body force: self-weightBody force: self-weight

A uniform body force is shared by all four nodes, a quarter each, because every Ni integrates to ab/4. Self-weight, fy = −ρg = −γ (unit weight γ), acts in −y, so it loads only the v-dofs:Body force yang seragam dikongsi oleh keempat-empat node, satu perempat setiap satu, kerana setiap Ni ber-integral kepada ab/4. Self-weight, fy = −ρg = −γ (berat unit γ), bertindak dalam −y, jadi ia hanya membebankan dof v:

Worked example · the global load vector of the cantilever (Activity 3, text (3.47))Contoh bekerja · global load vector cantilever (Aktiviti 3, teks (3.47))

Elements 2 (nodes 2, 3, 6, 5) and 4 (nodes 5, 6, 9, 8) have their side 2–3 on the free end. Each puts −2500 N on its local v2 and v3, which are global U6, U12 for element 2 and U12, U18 for element 4. Node 6 is shared, so U12 collects −5000 N: the full 5 kN m−1 × 1 m of edge around it.Element 2 (node 2, 3, 6, 5) dan 4 (node 5, 6, 9, 8) mempunyai sisi 2–3 pada hujung bebas. Setiap satu meletakkan −2500 N pada v2 dan v3 local-nya, iaitu U6, U12 global bagi element 2 dan U12, U18 bagi element 4. Node 6 dikongsi, jadi U12 mengumpul −5000 N: keseluruhan 5 kN m−1 × 1 m tepi di sekelilingnya.

(3.47)

The six entries Bi at the fixed dofs 1, 2, 7, 8, 13 and 14 are the unknown support reactions. The total applied load is −10 000 N, which the reactions must balance.Enam entri Bi pada dof fixed 1, 2, 7, 8, 13 dan 14 ialah support reaction yang tidak diketahui. Jumlah load yang dikenakan ialah −10 000 N, yang mesti diimbangi oleh reaction.

Key pointsPerkara utama
  • Uniform edge load: p ℓ/2 at each of the two edge nodes, only in the dofs of its direction.Edge load seragam: p ℓ/2 pada setiap satu daripada dua node tepi, hanya pada dof arahnya.
  • Linearly varying: ℓ(2pi + pj)/6 and ℓ(pi + 2pj)/6; self-weight: γtab/4 in each v-dof.Berubah secara linear: ℓ(2pi + pj)/6 dan ℓ(pi + 2pj)/6; self-weight: γtab/4 pada setiap dof v.
  • Cantilever: R6 = R18 = −2500 N, R12 = −5000 N; six unknown reactions.Cantilever: R6 = R18 = −2500 N, R12 = −5000 N; enam reaction yang tidak diketahui.

Each shape function integrates to ab/4, so each node carries a quarter of the weight γtab, and the weight acts in −y: only v1…v4 are loaded. Putting it all on the bottom nodes, or into the u-dofs, changes the load the element feels.Setiap shape function ber-integral kepada ab/4, jadi setiap node membawa satu perempat berat γtab, dan berat itu bertindak dalam −y: hanya v1…v4 dibebankan. Meletakkan semuanya pada node bawah, atau pada dof u, mengubah load yang dirasai element.

Read the solution like a structural engineer (Activity 5)Baca penyelesaian seperti jurutera struktur (Aktiviti 5)

  • The bottom fibre shortens (u2, u3 < 0) and the top lengthens (u8, u9 > 0) by the same amounts: antisymmetric bending about mid-height, an exact property of this symmetric mesh and load.Gentian bawah memendek (u2, u3 < 0) dan gentian atas memanjang (u8, u9 > 0) dengan jumlah yang sama: lenturan antisimetri tentang tengah ketinggian, sifat tepat mesh dan load yang simetri ini.

Reactions: the first check of any solutionReaction: semakan pertama bagi mana-mana penyelesaian

Evaluate the struck rows, [K]{U} − {R}, at the six fixed dofs. Their sum must balance the applied load and their moment must balance its moment about the fixed edge. The 2 × 2 mesh gives exactly these values, as every correct model must, whatever its mesh:Nilaikan baris yang dibuang, [K]{U} − {R}, pada enam dof fixed. Jumlahnya mesti mengimbangi load yang dikenakan dan momennya mesti mengimbangi momen load itu terhadap tepi fixed. Mesh 2 × 2 memberi nilai ini dengan tepat, seperti yang mesti diberi oleh setiap model yang betul, tanpa mengira mesh-nya:

In the 2 × 2 cantilever, why is u = 0 at nodes 5 and 6?Dalam cantilever 2 × 2, mengapa u = 0 pada node 5 dan 6?

Under bending the fibres above mid-height stretch and those below shorten by the same amount, so the mid-height line neither stretches nor shortens. Only nodes 1, 4 and 7 are supported, and only their rows were struck.Di bawah lenturan, gentian di atas tengah ketinggian meregang dan yang di bawah memendek dengan jumlah yang sama, jadi garis tengah ketinggian tidak meregang mahupun memendek. Hanya node 1, 4 dan 7 yang ditahan, dan hanya barisnya yang dibuang.

6. Is the answer right? Beam theory, refinement and shear lockingAdakah jawapan betul? Beam theory, refinement dan shear locking

≈ 10 min

The computer will always return numbers. Whether they are right is the engineer’s question, and it has two independent answers: compare with a simpler theory, and refine the mesh until the answer stops moving.Komputer akan sentiasa memulangkan nombor. Sama ada nombor itu betul ialah soalan jurutera, dan ia ada dua jawapan yang bebas: bandingkan dengan teori yang lebih mudah, dan refine mesh sehingga jawapan berhenti berubah.

A hand check: Timoshenko beam theorySemakan tangan: Timoshenko beam theory

The plate is a deep cantilever (L/H = 2) carrying P = qyH = 10 kN at its end. Elementary bending gives PL³/(3EI); because the beam is deep, shear deformation adds PL/(κGA) with κ = 5/6:Plat ini ialah cantilever dalam (L/H = 2) yang membawa P = qyH = 10 kN di hujungnya. Lenturan asas memberi PL³/(3EI); kerana beam ini dalam, shear deformation menambah PL/(κGA) dengan κ = 5/6:

Keep four figures when the difference is smallKekalkan empat angka apabila perbezaannya kecilRounded to three decimals, 0.189 against 0.192, the 16 × 16 error would look like −1.6%; with four figures, as on the Activity 6 slide, it is −1.4%. A percentage difference of two close numbers is only as good as the digits you keep.Dibundarkan kepada tiga tempat perpuluhan, 0.189 berbanding 0.192, ralat 16 × 16 akan kelihatan seperti −1.6%; dengan empat angka, seperti pada slide Aktiviti 6, ia −1.4%. Perbezaan peratus dua nombor yang hampir hanya setepat digit yang anda simpan.

Refine until the answer stops movingRefine sehingga jawapan berhenti berubah

Elements that are long in the bending direction (a/b = 4 in the 2 × 4 mesh) lock most. The same experiment in another code: the error falls with the element size, then levels off near 0.7%, because the load is applied as a uniform end traction while the exact solution assumes a parabolic end shear. Refining removes mesh error, not idealisation error. Images: SolidsPy (J. Gómez and N. Guarín-Zapata), MIT licence.Eksperimen yang sama dalam kod lain: ralat jatuh bersama saiz element, kemudian mendatar dekat 0.7%, kerana load dikenakan sebagai traction hujung yang seragam manakala penyelesaian tepat mengandaikan shear hujung parabolic. Refinement menghapuskan ralat mesh, bukan ralat idealisation. Imej: SolidsPy (J. Gómez dan N. Guarín-Zapata), lesen MIT.

The project rulePeraturan projekThree meshes, one table, one independent check (beam theory, the reactions, or a textbook solution). Then, and only then, a conclusion. Never report a single-mesh answer.Tiga mesh, satu jadual, satu semakan bebas (beam theory, reaction, atau penyelesaian buku teks). Kemudian, dan hanya kemudian, satu kesimpulan. Jangan sekali-kali melaporkan jawapan daripada satu mesh sahaja.

The script, as a diff against Heat Transfer Part 2Skrip, sebagai perbezaan daripada Heat Transfer Part 2

% ---- changes from the heat script ----
Lx = 4; Ly = 2;                 % plate 4 m x 2 m
E = 200e6; nu = 0.33; t = 0.01;
Nx = 2; Ny = 2; ndof = 18;      % 2 dofs per node
a = Lx/Nx; b = Ly/Ny;
% 12 closed-form values, text (3.42)
s1 = E*t*((1-nu)*a^2 + 2*b^2)/(6*(1-nu^2)*a*b);
s2 = E*t*((1-nu) + 2*nu)/(8*(1-nu^2));
% ... s3 to s12 likewise ...
k = [s1 s2 s3 s4 s5 s6 s7 s8; ...];  % 8 x 8 pattern of (3.42)
% assembly with the dof map (node n -> 2n-1, 2n)
K = zeros(ndof); F = zeros(ndof,1);
d1 = [1 2 3 4 9 10 7 8];       K(d1,d1) = K(d1,d1) + k;
d2 = [3 4 5 6 11 12 9 10];     K(d2,d2) = K(d2,d2) + k;
d3 = [7 8 9 10 15 16 13 14];   K(d3,d3) = K(d3,d3) + k;
d4 = [9 10 11 12 17 18 15 16]; K(d4,d4) = K(d4,d4) + k;
F([6 12 18]) = [-2500 -5000 -2500];   % edge traction, (3.47)
fixed = [1 2 7 8 13 14];  free = setdiff(1:ndof, fixed);
U = zeros(ndof,1);  U(free) = K(free,free) \ F(free);   % (3.49)
  • Two dofs per node: ndof = 2 × nodes, and each element’s dof list replaces its node list.Dua dof setiap node: ndof = 2 × node, dan senarai dof setiap element menggantikan senarai node-nya.
  • The 4 × 4 conductance pattern becomes the 8 × 8 pattern of (3.42).Pola conductance 4 × 4 menjadi pola 8 × 8 daripada (3.42).
  • Loads in the v-dofs of the loaded edge; six fixed dofs instead of fixed temperatures. The solve line is unchanged.Load pada dof v tepi yang dibebankan; enam dof fixed menggantikan temperature tetap. Baris penyelesaian tidak berubah.

The Python version, fe_plane_stress.py, is in the Explorer tab; it builds [k] by Gauss quadrature, reproduces (3.49) and runs the convergence study above.Versi Python, fe_plane_stress.py, ada dalam tab Explorer; ia membina [k] melalui Gauss quadrature, menghasilkan semula (3.49) dan menjalankan kajian convergence di atas.

Key pointsPerkara utama
  • Two independent checks: beam theory (0.192 m) and mesh refinement; plus the reactions.Dua semakan bebas: beam theory (0.192 m) dan mesh refinement; serta reaction.
  • The 2 × 2 Q4 mesh is 32% too stiff: straight-sided elements lock in bending.Mesh Q4 2 × 2 terlalu stiff sebanyak 32%: element bertepi lurus mengalami locking dalam lenturan.
  • About 32 elements along the length for 1%; elements long in the bending direction lock most.Kira-kira 32 element sepanjang panjangnya untuk 1%; element yang panjang dalam arah lenturan paling teruk locking.
Quick check · not gradedSemak cepat · tidak bergred

The same eight Q4 elements as a 4 × 2 mesh or as a 2 × 4 mesh. Which is stiffer?Lapan element Q4 yang sama sebagai mesh 4 × 2 atau sebagai mesh 2 × 4. Yang mana lebih stiff?

2 × 4 gives −0.133 m against −0.164 m for 4 × 2: the 2 m × 0.5 m elements cannot curve along their length, so they develop most spurious shear. The count of elements is the same; their shape is not.2 × 4 memberi −0.133 m berbanding −0.164 m bagi 4 × 2: element 2 m × 0.5 m tidak boleh melengkung sepanjang panjangnya, jadi ia menghasilkan shear palsu paling banyak. Bilangan element sama; bentuknya tidak.

Example 1 · Stiffness matrix of a square elementContoh 1 · Stiffness matrix bagi element segi empat sama

Exam typeJenis soalan entries of [k] by integration and by patternUnitsUnit kN, mSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Example 9.2 (textbook Exercise 3.1)20 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalanA square plane-stress element of side 0.5 m and thickness 0.05 m has E = 2.05 × 10⁸ kN m−2 and ν = 0.3. (a) Obtain k11 and k12 by integration, (b) write [k], and (c) check it.Satu element plane stress segi empat sama bersisi 0.5 m dan tebal 0.05 m mempunyai E = 2.05 × 10⁸ kN m−2 dan ν = 0.3. (a) Dapatkan k11 dan k12 melalui integration, (b) tulis [k], dan (c) semak.

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. k11 is the force in x at node 1 that moves node 1 one unit in x with every other dof held. The movement shortens side 1–2, resisted by Ē = E/(1 − ν²), and shears the element, because node 1 moves while node 4 above it does not, resisted by G. k12, the force in y that comes with it, arises from the Poisson effect and from the same shear.k11 ialah daya dalam x pada node 1 yang menggerakkan node 1 satu unit dalam x dengan setiap dof lain ditahan. Pergerakan itu memendekkan sisi 1–2, ditentang oleh Ē = E/(1 − ν²), dan men-shear element, kerana node 1 bergerak manakala node 4 di atasnya tidak, ditentang oleh G. k12, daya dalam y yang menyertainya, timbul daripada kesan Poisson dan daripada shear yang sama.

Plan. Columns 1 and 2 of [B] → integrate k11 and k12 → s1 to s12 → [k] by the pattern (3.42) → row sums and a rigid rotation.

Step 1 (a) Columns 1 and 2 of [B](a) Lajur 1 dan 2 [B][2]

with Ē = E/(1 − ν²) and G = Ē(1 − ν)/2 in [E].dengan Ē = E/(1 − ν²) dan G = Ē(1 − ν)/2 dalam [E].

Answer. (b) s1 = 5.069, s2 = 1.830, s3 = −3.098, s5 = −2.534, s7 = 0.563, s8 = 0.141 (× 10⁶ kN m−1); [k] as tabulated.

Step 5 (c) Checks(c) Semakan[6]

Check. Symmetric; u- and v-entries of row 1 each sum to zero; a rigid rotation gives zero force. The other rows check in the same way.

Answer. (c) [k] passes the three rigid-body checks.
InterpretationTafsiranThe u–u entries are those of a heat element with kx = Et/(1 − ν²) and ky = Gt: moving u along x stretches the material, moving it along y shears it. As for a square heat element, the stiffness does not depend on the side: doubling a and b leaves [k] unchanged, so only E, ν and t matter. The coupling terms s2 and s8 are independent of the element’s size and shape; with ν = 1/3, s8 would vanish.Entri u–u ialah entri element haba dengan kx = Et/(1 − ν²) dan ky = Gt: menggerakkan u sepanjang x meregangkan bahan, menggerakkannya sepanjang y men-shear bahan. Seperti element haba segi empat sama, stiffness tidak bergantung pada sisinya: menggandakan a dan b tidak mengubah [k], jadi hanya E, ν dan t yang penting. Term gandingan s2 dan s8 tidak bergantung pada saiz dan bentuk element; dengan ν = 1/3, s8 akan lenyap.

Example 2 · Nodal loads, and global entries from a given element matrixContoh 2 · Nodal load, dan entri global daripada matrix element yang diberi

Exam typeJenis soalan edge load and body force; KIJ from [k] and the connectivityUnitsUnit kN, mSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Examples 9.3 (textbook Exercise 3.2) and 9.420 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalanFor the element of Example 1, determine the nodal loads for (a) a load of −25 kN m−1 in y on its right side, (b) the self-weight of steel, γ = 78.5 kN m−3, and (c) a load in y varying linearly along the right side from 0 at node 2 to −25 kN m−1 at node 3. (d) The structure in the figure below is modelled by four identical elements whose matrix, in the local dof order of Example 1, is given. Determine K9,11, K16,16, K8,7 and K13,20.Bagi element Contoh 1, tentukan nodal load untuk (a) load −25 kN m−1 dalam y pada sisi kanannya, (b) self-weight keluli, γ = 78.5 kN m−3, dan (c) load dalam y yang berubah secara linear sepanjang sisi kanan daripada 0 pada node 2 kepada −25 kN m−1 pada node 3. (d) Struktur dalam rajah di bawah dimodelkan dengan empat element serupa yang matrix-nya, dalam susunan dof local Contoh 1, diberi. Tentukan K9,11, K16,16, K8,7 dan K13,20.

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. A uniform load is shared equally by the two nodes of its side, and a uniform body force by the four nodes of the element. A load that grows towards node 3 must put more on node 3, with its resultant at two thirds of the side from node 2. In (d) each global entry collects the stiffness every element contributes between its two dofs; only elements that contain both nodes contribute.Load yang seragam dikongsi sama rata oleh dua node sisinya, dan body force yang seragam oleh empat node element. Load yang membesar ke arah node 3 mesti meletakkan lebih pada node 3, dengan paduannya pada dua pertiga sisi dari node 2. Dalam (d), setiap entri global mengumpul stiffness yang disumbangkan setiap element antara dua dof-nya; hanya element yang mengandungi kedua-dua node menyumbang.

Plan. (a) pℓ/2 → (b) γtab/4 → (c) ℓ(2pi + pj)/6 with total and moment checks → (d) dof → node → elements containing both → local positions → sum.

InterpretationTafsiranThe loads go only to the dofs in the direction of the load; an edge load in y gives nothing to the u-dofs. The shares are the consistent loads of the bar element, because along a side the Q4 shape functions are the linear functions of a bar; the total and the moment are the two checks that catch a wrong share. In (d) the given matrix has the pattern of (3.42) for a square, with ν = 0.25 and Et = 5 in the units of the question, which reproduces every entry:
K8,7 shows the u–v coupling at a node changing sign from one element to the next, so contributions from elements on different sides of a node partly cancel; at an interior node of a regular mesh they cancel completely.Load hanya pergi ke dof dalam arah load itu; edge load dalam y tidak memberi apa-apa kepada dof u. Bahagian itu ialah consistent load bar element, kerana di sepanjang sisi shape function Q4 ialah fungsi linear bar; jumlah dan momen ialah dua semakan yang menangkap bahagian yang salah. Dalam (d), matrix yang diberi mempunyai pola (3.42) bagi segi empat sama, dengan ν = 0.25 dan Et = 5 dalam unit soalan, yang menghasilkan semula setiap entri:
K8,7 menunjukkan gandingan u–v pada satu node bertukar tanda dari satu element ke element seterusnya, jadi sumbangan element di sisi berlainan sesuatu node sebahagiannya terbatal; pada node dalaman mesh yang seragam ia terbatal sepenuhnya.

Example 3 · One element in tension: rollers and a clamped edgeContoh 3 · Satu element dalam tegangan: roller dan tepi clamped

Exam typeJenis soalan supports, symmetry, comparison with the exact fieldUnitsUnit kN, mSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Example 9.620 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalanA square plate 1 m × 1 m and 0.01 m thick (E = 200 × 10⁶ kN m−2, ν = 0.3) is pulled by a uniform stress σ = 1000 kN m−2 on its right side and modelled by one element. Find the nodal displacements (a) with rollers, u1 = u4 = 0 and v1 = v2 = 0, and (b) with the left side clamped, u1 = v1 = u4 = v4 = 0.Satu plat segi empat sama 1 m × 1 m dan tebal 0.01 m (E = 200 × 10⁶ kN m−2, ν = 0.3) ditarik oleh stress seragam σ = 1000 kN m−2 pada sisi kanannya dan dimodelkan dengan satu element. Cari nodal displacement (a) dengan roller, u1 = u4 = 0 dan v1 = v2 = 0, dan (b) dengan sisi kiri clamped, u1 = v1 = u4 = v4 = 0.

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. On rollers the plate is free to contract sideways, so the stress is uniform: it stretches by σ/E = 5 × 10−6 and contracts by νσ/E = 1.5 × 10−6 per metre. That field is linear, and a Q4 contains linear fields, so (a) should come out exact. Clamped, the left side cannot contract, which stiffens the plate near the support: expect a slightly smaller stretch in (b), and the right-hand corners moving towards the centre line.Di atas roller, plat bebas mengecut ke sisi, jadi stress-nya seragam: ia meregang sebanyak σ/E = 5 × 10−6 dan mengecut sebanyak νσ/E = 1.5 × 10−6 per meter. Field itu linear, dan Q4 mengandungi field linear, jadi (a) sepatutnya tepat. Apabila clamped, sisi kiri tidak dapat mengecut, yang menjadikan plat lebih stiff berhampiran support: jangkakan regangan yang sedikit lebih kecil dalam (b), dan bucu kanan bergerak ke arah garis tengah.

Plan. s1 to s12 → loads σtℓ/2 → (a) substitute the exact field into the reduced equations → (b) symmetry u3 = u2, v3 = −v2 → a 2 × 2 system → reactions.

Step 1 Element matrix and loadsMatrix element dan load[4]

For the unit square s9 = s1, s10 = s7, s11 = s5, s12 = s3, s6 = −s2, s8 = −s4.Bagi segi empat sama unit s9 = s1, s10 = s7, s11 = s5, s12 = s3, s6 = −s2, s8 = −s4.

Step 2 (a) Rollers: the exact field satisfies the equations(a) Roller: field tepat memenuhi persamaan[6]

The unknowns are u2, u3, v3, v4. Try the exact field:Unknown-nya ialah u2, u3, v3, v4. Cuba field tepat:

In row u2 (row 3 of [k]) only four terms remain (si in 10⁶ kN m−1, displacements in 10−6 m):Dalam baris u2 (baris 3 [k]) hanya empat term tinggal (si dalam 10⁶ kN m−1, displacement dalam 10−6 m):

Rows u3, v3 and v4 give 5, 0 and 0 in the same way, so the exact field is the solution.Baris u3, v3 dan v4 memberi 5, 0 dan 0 dengan cara yang sama, jadi field tepat itulah penyelesaiannya.

Answer. (a) u2 = u3 = 5.0 × 10−6 m, v3 = v4 = −1.5 × 10−6 m, exact.

Step 3 (b) Clamped: symmetry gives a 2 × 2 system(b) Clamped: simetri memberi sistem 2 × 2[6]

The unknowns are u2, v2, u3, v3. Plate and load are symmetric about mid-height, so u3 = u2 and v3 = −v2; rows u2 and v2 (rows 3 and 4 of [k]) becomeUnknown-nya ialah u2, v2, u3, v3. Plat dan load simetri tentang tengah ketinggian, jadi u3 = u2 dan v3 = −v2; baris u2 dan v2 (baris 3 dan 4 [k]) menjadi

Answer. (b) u2 = u3 = 4.85 × 10−6 m (3.0% less than on rollers), v2 = −v3 = 1.00 × 10−6 m.

Step 4 Reactions as a checkReaction sebagai semakan[4]

From rows 1, 2, 7 and 8 of [k]{d} − {r}:Daripada baris 1, 2, 7 dan 8 bagi [k]{d} − {r}:

Check. The horizontal reactions balance the 10 kN pull; the vertical ones are equal and opposite, so they have no resultant.

InterpretationTafsiran(a) is the patch test: a uniform stress is reproduced exactly by one element, and therefore by any mesh of such elements; an element that failed it could not converge. (b) shows the effect of a support that prevents the Poisson contraction: the clamped side carries vertical reactions, −0.99 kN at node 1 and +0.99 kN at node 4, that hold its corners apart, and the resulting tension in y reduces the stretch in x by 3.0%. A fine mesh gives a mean stretch of the loaded side 1.2% below the free value, so one element overstates the restraint, because it spreads the effect of the clamped side over the whole plate.(a) ialah patch test: stress yang seragam dihasilkan semula dengan tepat oleh satu element, dan oleh itu oleh mana-mana mesh element sedemikian; element yang gagal ujian ini tidak boleh converge. (b) menunjukkan kesan support yang menghalang pengecutan Poisson: sisi clamped membawa reaction menegak, −0.99 kN pada node 1 dan +0.99 kN pada node 4, yang menahan bucunya daripada mendekat, dan tegangan dalam y yang terhasil mengurangkan regangan dalam x sebanyak 3.0%. Mesh halus memberi regangan purata sisi yang dibebankan 1.2% di bawah nilai bebas, jadi satu element melebih-lebihkan kekangan itu, kerana ia menyebarkan kesan sisi clamped ke seluruh plat.

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

[B] = [∂]ᵀ[N] = (3 × 2)(2 × 8) = 3 × 8. The 2 × 8 matrix is [N] itself; the 8 × 8 symmetric matrix is [k] = t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA.[B] = [∂]ᵀ[N] = (3 × 2)(2 × 8) = 3 × 8. Matrix 2 × 8 ialah [N] itu sendiri; matrix simetri 8 × 8 ialah [k] = t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA.

A2 · 1 markmarkah
Which entries of a rectangle’s [k] do not depend on the element’s sides a and b?Entri [k] segi empat tepat yang mana tidak bergantung pada sisi element a dan b?

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

Each u–v coupling integrates the product of an x-derivative and a y-derivative, such as x(b − y)/(a²b²), whose integral over the element is ±1/4 whatever a and b are: s2 = Et/(8(1 − ν)). The diagonals contain a/b and b/a.Setiap gandingan u–v meng-integrate hasil darab satu x-derivative dan satu y-derivative, seperti x(b − y)/(a²b²), yang integral-nya atas element ialah ±1/4 tanpa mengira a dan b: s2 = Et/(8(1 − ν)). Pepenjuru mengandungi a/b dan b/a.

C1 · 2 marksmarkah
An element with a = 2 m, b = 1 m and t = 0.01 m carries a downward traction of 500 kN m−2 (force per unit area) on its right side, 2–3. A student finds the nodal loads. One line contains the slip. Which one?Satu element dengan a = 2 m, b = 1 m dan t = 0.01 m membawa traction ke bawah 500 kN m−2 (daya per unit luas) pada sisi kanannya, 2–3. Seorang pelajar mencari nodal load. Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

Line 4: the traction acts in y, so the loads belong in the v-dofs of nodes 2 and 3, local dofs 4 and 6: r4 = r6 = −2.5 kN, and r3 = r5 = 0. The total in line 5 could not catch it, because the sum is the same whichever dofs receive the shares; the check that does is to ask which displacement the load does work on.Baris 4: traction bertindak dalam y, jadi load itu milik dof v node 2 dan 3, iaitu dof local 4 dan 6: r4 = r6 = −2.5 kN, dan r3 = r5 = 0. Jumlah pada baris 5 tidak dapat menangkapnya, kerana jumlahnya sama tidak kira dof mana yang menerima bahagian itu; semakan yang berkesan ialah bertanya displacement mana yang dikenakan kerja oleh load itu.

Guna untuk menyemak setiap matrix dan nombor dalam pengiraan tangan, dan untuk menjalankan apa yang tidak praktikal dibuat dengan tangan: kajian mesh, contour plot, geometri dan beban anda sendiri.

  1. Unzip, then install Python 3.8 or newer and run pip install numpy matplotlib (matplotlib only for the plots).Unzip, kemudian pasang Python 3.8 atau lebih baharu dan jalankan pip install numpy matplotlib (matplotlib hanya untuk plot).

  3. Read the docstring at the top of the file for the notation, numbering and units, and how to call it for your own problem.Baca docstring di bahagian atas fail untuk notasi, penomboran dan unit, dan cara memanggilnya untuk masalah anda sendiri.

Show the codeTunjuk kod · fe_plane_stress.py · 323 linesbaris
"""
SEAA 4243 Finite Element Method - plane stress with 4-node and 8-node elements
==============================================================================

Companion code for the Cantilever and Stress Recovery Explorers (Plane Stress).
It follows the course's steps in the text's notation (Mohd Yassin et al.,
MSNM 2020, Chapter 3):

    [E]   3 x 3 material matrix, plane stress or plane strain       text (3.10)
    [B]   strains from nodal displacements, {eps} = [d]^T[N]{u}     weak form (3.31)-(3.38)
    [k]   = t * integral [B]^T [E] [B] dA                          closed form (3.42);
          here by Gauss quadrature (2 x 2 points for the 4-node
          element, 3 x 3 for the 8-node), which reproduces (3.42)
    loads a uniform traction on the free end becomes consistent nodal
          loads: q b/2 to each node (4-node, (3.45)); q b/6, 2q b/3,
          q b/6 (8-node, (3.51))
    solve assemble (3.46), strike the fixed edge's rows and columns
          (3.48), solve (3.49); reactions from the struck rows;
          stresses {sigma} = [E][B]{u} at any point; principal stresses,
          von Mises, and nodal averaging as in ANSYS.

The built-in problem is the text's cantilever: a plate 4 m x 2 m,
t = 0.01 m, E = 200e6 N/m2, nu = 0.33, fixed at x = 0, loaded at x = 4 by a
uniform downward traction of 5000 N per metre of edge (P = 10 kN in total).
The functions take any L, H, mesh, material, thickness and load.

Mesh and numbering
    4-node: nodes left to right, then bottom to top (the text's 2 x 2 mesh:
    nodes 1-3 along the bottom). dof 2i-1 = u_i, dof 2i = v_i (1-based).
    8-node: corner and mid-side nodes are numbered in the order they are
    created; use node_at(res, x, y) to find a node.

Units
    Any consistent set. The example uses N and m, so stresses come out in
    N/m2 (divide by 1e3 for kN/m2). The traction q is force per unit length
    of the loaded edge (N/m), the thickness already included.

Run
    python fe_plane_stress.py
        reproduces the 2 x 2 cantilever (tip deflection, reactions, stresses
        at (3.5, 1.3)), the convergence of the 4- and 8-node meshes against
        Timoshenko beam theory, and the growth of the stress at the fixed
        corner; saves a von Mises contour plot if matplotlib is installed.

Use for your own model
    from fe_plane_stress import solve_cantilever, stress_at, principal, von_mises
    res = solve_cantilever(L=4, H=2, Nx=8, Ny=4, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000, nen=8)
    s = stress_at(res, 2.0, 1.3)        # (sxx, syy, sxy)

A hand calculation is still a hand calculation: use this script to check your
matrices and numbers, and to run the mesh study a project needs.
Dense numpy solver: fine up to a few thousand degrees of freedom.

Requires Python 3.8+ and numpy; matplotlib only for the plot.
Course SEAA 4243, Faculty of Civil Engineering, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia.
Code: MIT licence.
"""
import numpy as np


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Material
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def E_matrix(E, nu, plane="stress"):
    """[E] of text (3.10) for plane stress; plane strain when plane = "strain"."""
    if plane == "stress":
        c = E / (1 - nu ** 2)
        return c * np.array([[1, nu, 0], [nu, 1, 0], [0, 0, (1 - nu) / 2]])
    c = E / ((1 + nu) * (1 - 2 * nu))
    return c * np.array([[1 - nu, nu, 0], [nu, 1 - nu, 0], [0, 0, (1 - 2 * nu) / 2]])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shape functions in natural coordinates xi, eta in [-1, 1]
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XI = np.array([-1, 1, 1, -1, 0, 1, 0, -1], dtype=float)
ETA = np.array([-1, -1, 1, 1, -1, 0, 1, 0], dtype=float)


def shape(nen, xi, eta):
    """N (nen,) and dN/dxi, dN/deta (2, nen) of the 4-node or 8-node element."""
    if nen == 4:
        N = 0.25 * (1 + XI[:4] * xi) * (1 + ETA[:4] * eta)
        dN = np.vstack([0.25 * XI[:4] * (1 + ETA[:4] * eta), 0.25 * ETA[:4] * (1 + XI[:4] * xi)])
        return N, dN
    N = np.zeros(8); dN = np.zeros((2, 8))
    for i in range(4):
        cx, cy = XI[i], ETA[i]
        N[i] = 0.25 * (1 + cx * xi) * (1 + cy * eta) * (cx * xi + cy * eta - 1)
        dN[0, i] = 0.25 * cx * (1 + cy * eta) * (2 * cx * xi + cy * eta)
        dN[1, i] = 0.25 * cy * (1 + cx * xi) * (cx * xi + 2 * cy * eta)
    N[4] = 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2) * (1 - eta); dN[:, 4] = [-xi * (1 - eta), -0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2)]
    N[5] = 0.5 * (1 + xi) * (1 - eta ** 2); dN[:, 5] = [0.5 * (1 - eta ** 2), -eta * (1 + xi)]
    N[6] = 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2) * (1 + eta); dN[:, 6] = [-xi * (1 + eta), 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2)]
    N[7] = 0.5 * (1 - xi) * (1 - eta ** 2); dN[:, 7] = [-0.5 * (1 - eta ** 2), -eta * (1 - xi)]
    return N, dN


def B_matrix(nen, a, b, xi, eta):
    """[B] (3 x 2nen) of an a x b rectangle at (xi, eta): rows exx, eyy, gamma_xy."""
    _, dN = shape(nen, xi, eta)
    dx, dy = dN[0] * 2 / a, dN[1] * 2 / b
    B = np.zeros((3, 2 * nen))
    B[0, 0::2] = dx
    B[1, 1::2] = dy
    B[2, 0::2] = dy
    B[2, 1::2] = dx
    return B


def element_stiffness(nen, a, b, Em, t):
    """[k] = t * integral [B]^T[E][B] dA by Gauss quadrature (2 x 2 for Q4, 3 x 3 for Q8)."""
    g, w = np.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(2 if nen == 4 else 3)
    k = np.zeros((2 * nen, 2 * nen))
    for xi, wi in zip(g, w):
        for eta, wj in zip(g, w):
            B = B_matrix(nen, a, b, xi, eta)
            k += t * (a / 2) * (b / 2) * wi * wj * B.T @ Em @ B
    return k


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mesh
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def mesh(nen, L, H, Nx, Ny):
    a, b = L / Nx, H / Ny
    if nen == 4:
        nodes = np.array([(i * a, j * b) for j in range(Ny + 1) for i in range(Nx + 1)], dtype=float)
        conn = [[j * (Nx + 1) + i, j * (Nx + 1) + i + 1, (j + 1) * (Nx + 1) + i + 1, (j + 1) * (Nx + 1) + i]
                for j in range(Ny) for i in range(Nx)]
        return a, b, nodes, np.array(conn, dtype=int)
    ids, nodes = {}, []
    def node(x, y):
        key = (round(x, 9), round(y, 9))
        if key not in ids:
            ids[key] = len(nodes); nodes.append((x, y))
        return ids[key]
    conn = []
    for j in range(Ny):
        for i in range(Nx):
            x0, y0 = i * a, j * b
            conn.append([node(x0, y0), node(x0 + a, y0), node(x0 + a, y0 + b), node(x0, y0 + b),
                         node(x0 + a / 2, y0), node(x0 + a, y0 + b / 2), node(x0 + a / 2, y0 + b), node(x0, y0 + b / 2)])
    return a, b, np.array(nodes, dtype=float), np.array(conn, dtype=int)


def dofs_of(c):
    return np.ravel([[2 * n, 2 * n + 1] for n in c])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve the cantilever
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def solve_cantilever(L=4.0, H=2.0, Nx=2, Ny=2, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000.0,
                     nen=4, plane="stress", load="edge"):
    """Fixed at x = 0; vertical load on x = L. load = "edge": uniform traction q (N/m)
    by consistent nodal loads; load = "point": the total q*H at the top-right node."""
    Em = E_matrix(E, nu, plane)
    a, b, nodes, conn = mesh(nen, L, H, Nx, Ny)
    n = len(nodes)
    K = np.zeros((2 * n, 2 * n))
    F = np.zeros(2 * n)
    k = element_stiffness(nen, a, b, Em, t)
    for c in conn:
        d = dofs_of(c)
        K[np.ix_(d, d)] += k                                   # scatter-add by dof map
    if load == "point":
        F[2 * node_at_xy(nodes, L, H) + 1] += q * H
    else:
        for c in conn:
            if np.isclose(nodes[c[1], 0], L):                   # element side 2-3 on the loaded edge
                if nen == 4:
                    F[2 * c[1] + 1] += q * b / 2; F[2 * c[2] + 1] += q * b / 2
                else:
                    F[2 * c[1] + 1] += q * b / 6; F[2 * c[5] + 1] += 2 * q * b / 3; F[2 * c[2] + 1] += q * b / 6
    fixed_nodes = np.where(np.isclose(nodes[:, 0], 0.0))[0]
    known = dofs_of(fixed_nodes)
    free = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(2 * n), known)
    U = np.zeros(2 * n)
    U[free] = np.linalg.solve(K[np.ix_(free, free)], F[free])
    Rk = K[known] @ U - F[known]                               # struck rows: support reactions
    Rx, Ry = Rk[0::2].sum(), Rk[1::2].sum()
    M = sum(-(nodes[nd, 1] - H / 2) * Rk[2 * i] for i, nd in enumerate(fixed_nodes))
    return dict(nen=nen, L=L, H=H, Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, a=a, b=b, E=E, nu=nu, t=t, q=q, plane=plane, Em=Em,
                nodes=nodes, conn=conn, K=K, F=F, U=U, known=known, reactions=dict(Rx=Rx, Ry=Ry, M=M),
                tip=U[2 * node_at_xy(nodes, L, H) + 1])


def node_at_xy(nodes, x, y):
    return int(np.argmin(np.hypot(nodes[:, 0] - x, nodes[:, 1] - y)))


def node_at(res, x, y):
    """0-based index of the node nearest to (x, y)."""
    return node_at_xy(res["nodes"], x, y)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stresses
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def locate(res, x, y):
    """Element containing (x, y) and the natural coordinates of the point in it."""
    i = min(res["Nx"] - 1, max(0, int(np.floor(x / res["a"] + 1e-12))))
    j = min(res["Ny"] - 1, max(0, int(np.floor(y / res["b"] + 1e-12))))
    e = j * res["Nx"] + i
    x1, y1 = res["nodes"][res["conn"][e][0]]
    return e, 2 * (x - x1) / res["a"] - 1, 2 * (y - y1) / res["b"] - 1


def stress_in_element(res, e, xi, eta):
    c = res["conn"][e]
    B = B_matrix(res["nen"], res["a"], res["b"], xi, eta)
    return res["Em"] @ (B @ res["U"][dofs_of(c)])


def stress_at(res, x, y):
    """(sxx, syy, sxy) at a global point, from the element that contains it."""
    e, xi, eta = locate(res, x, y)
    return stress_in_element(res, e, xi, eta)


def principal(s):
    """sigma1, sigma2 and the angle (degrees) of sigma1 from x: the Mohr circle."""
    c = (s[0] + s[1]) / 2
    R = np.hypot((s[0] - s[1]) / 2, s[2])
    return c + R, c - R, 0.5 * np.degrees(np.arctan2(2 * s[2], s[0] - s[1]))


def von_mises(s):
    """Plane-stress von Mises stress."""
    return np.sqrt(s[0] ** 2 - s[0] * s[1] + s[1] ** 2 + 3 * s[2] ** 2)


def nodal_stresses(res, mode="averaged"):
    """Stresses at the nodes, as post-processors show them.
    "unaveraged": each element's own value at its nodes, (ne, nen, 3) - jumps visible;
    "averaged":   the mean over the elements sharing each node, (n, 3);
    "centroid":   one value per element, (ne, 3)."""
    nen, conn = res["nen"], res["conn"]
    if mode == "centroid":
        return np.array([stress_in_element(res, e, 0, 0) for e in range(len(conn))])
    un = np.array([[stress_in_element(res, e, XI[i], ETA[i]) for i in range(nen)] for e in range(len(conn))])
    if mode == "unaveraged":
        return un
    n = len(res["nodes"])
    av = np.zeros((n, 3)); cnt = np.zeros(n)
    for e, c in enumerate(conn):
        for i, nd in enumerate(c):
            av[nd] += un[e, i]; cnt[nd] += 1
    return av / cnt[:, None]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Beam theory for comparison
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def timoshenko_tip(L, H, E, nu, t, q, plane="stress", kappa=5 / 6):
    """Tip deflection magnitude: bending PL^3/(3EI) plus shear PL/(kappa G A)."""
    P = -q * H
    I, A, G = t * H ** 3 / 12, t * H, E / (2 * (1 + nu))
    Eb = E / (1 - nu ** 2) if plane == "strain" else E
    return P * L ** 3 / (3 * Eb * I), P * L / (kappa * G * A)


def plot_von_mises(res, filename="von_mises.png"):
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        from matplotlib.ticker import MaxNLocator
    except ImportError:
        print("matplotlib is not installed: skipping the plot")
        return None
    xs = np.linspace(0, res["L"], 161); ys = np.linspace(0, res["H"], 81)
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(xs, ys)
    Z = np.vectorize(lambda x, y: von_mises(stress_at(res, x, y)) / 1e3)(X, Y)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.6))
    # the fixed corners are singular: cap the colour scale at the 99th percentile
    levels = MaxNLocator(nbins=20).tick_values(0, np.percentile(Z, 99))
    cf = ax.contourf(X, Y, Z, levels=levels, cmap="jet", extend="max")
    ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.set_xlabel("x (m)"); ax.set_ylabel("y (m)")
    fig.colorbar(cf, ax=ax, label="von Mises (kN/m2)")
    ax.set_title(f"{res['nen']}-node, {res['Nx']} x {res['Ny']} mesh")
    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    print("saved", filename)
    return filename


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Course examples
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=140)
    base = dict(L=4.0, H=2.0, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000.0)

    r = solve_cantilever(Nx=2, Ny=2, **base)
    print("Text cantilever, 4-node 2 x 2 mesh, (3.44)-(3.49) (nodes 1-3 along the bottom)")
    U = r["U"].reshape(-1, 2)
    for i, (u, v) in enumerate(U):
        print(f"  node {i + 1}: u = {u:+.6f}  v = {v:+.6f} m")
    print(f"  tip deflection = {r['tip']:.4f} m  (text: -0.131)")
    R = r["reactions"]
    print(f"  reactions: Rx = {R['Rx']:.1f} N, Ry = {R['Ry']:.1f} N, M = {R['M']:.1f} N m  (10 kN up, 40 kN m)")
    s = stress_at(r, 3.5, 1.3) / 1e3
    s1, s2, th = principal(s)
    print(f"  stress at (3.5, 1.3) = {np.round(s, 1)} kN/m2  (315.2, -44.9, -310.9)")
    print(f"  principal {s1:.1f}, {s2:.1f} kN/m2 at {th:.1f} deg; von Mises {von_mises(s):.1f}  (494.4, -224.1; 636.8)")

    bend, shear = timoshenko_tip(**base)
    print(f"\nConvergence of the tip deflection; Timoshenko beam {bend:.3f} + {shear:.3f} = {bend + shear:.3f} m")
    for nen, meshes in ((4, [(2, 1), (2, 2), (4, 2), (8, 4), (16, 8), (32, 16)]), (8, [(2, 1), (4, 2), (8, 4), (16, 8)])):
        for Nx, Ny in meshes:
            rr = solve_cantilever(Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, nen=nen, **base)
            print(f"  {nen}-node {Nx:2d} x {Ny:<2d} dofs {rr['U'].size:5d}  tip {rr['tip']:.4f} m")

    r8 = solve_cantilever(Nx=16, Ny=8, nen=8, **base)
    print(f"\n8-node 16 x 8: sxx(2.0, 1.3) = {stress_at(r8, 2.0, 1.3)[0] / 1e3:.1f} kN/m2 (beam theory 900);"
          f" sxx(3.5, 1.3) = {stress_at(r8, 3.5, 1.3)[0] / 1e3:.1f} (beam 225: end effect, St-Venant)")

    print("\nFixed corner: sxx at the centroid of the top-left element grows with every refinement (a singularity)")
    for Nx, Ny in ((8, 4), (16, 8), (32, 16)):
        rr = solve_cantilever(Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, **base)
        print(f"  4-node {Nx} x {Ny}: {stress_at(rr, rr['a'] / 2, 2 - rr['b'] / 2)[0] / 1e3:.0f} kN/m2")

    plot_von_mises(r8, "von_mises_q8_16x8.png")

GlossaryGlosari

What to doApa perlu dibuat Look up a term; type in the box to filter. Terms stay in English in both languages; the explanation follows the language you chose.Cari istilah; taip dalam kotak untuk menapis. Istilah kekal dalam bahasa Inggeris dalam kedua-dua bahasa; penjelasan mengikut bahasa yang anda pilih.

Not counted toward progress.Tidak dikira dalam kemajuan.

Galerkin, vector versionWeighted residual with [N]ᵀ as the weight: eight equations per four-node element, one per dof.Weighted residual dengan [N]ᵀ sebagai weight: lapan persamaan setiap four-node element, satu setiap dof.
strain–displacement matrix [B][B] = [∂]ᵀ[N], 3 × 8: the strains {ε} = [B]{û} at any point of the element; each row sums to zero.[B] = [∂]ᵀ[N], 3 × 8: strain {ε} = [B]{û} pada mana-mana titik element; setiap baris berjumlah sifar.
stiffness matrix [k]t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA, 8 × 8, symmetric; units force per length (N m−1 or kN m−1).t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA, 8 × 8, simetri; unit daya per panjang (N m−1 atau kN m−1).
stiffness influence coefficient kijForce at dof i needed to give dof j a unit displacement with every other dof held.Daya pada dof i yang diperlukan untuk memberi dof j satu unit displacement dengan setiap dof lain ditahan.
s1…s12The twelve distinct entries of a rectangle’s [k], text (3.42); s2, s4, s6, s8 (u–v couplings) do not depend on a, b.Dua belas entri berbeza [k] segi empat tepat, teks (3.42); s2, s4, s6, s8 (gandingan u–v) tidak bergantung pada a, b.
Ē = E/(1 − ν²)The plane-stress modulus that multiplies the normal terms of [E]; G = Ē(1 − ν)/2 is the shear modulus.Modulus plane stress yang mendarab term normal dalam [E]; G = Ē(1 − ν)/2 ialah shear modulus.
zero-energy (rigid-body) modesTwo translations and one rotation that cause no strain; [k]{d} = 0 for each, so [k] is singular until supported.Dua translation dan satu rotation yang tidak menyebabkan strain; [k]{d} = 0 bagi setiap satu, jadi [k] singular sehingga ditahan.
row-sum checkIn every row of [k] the u-entries and the v-entries each add up to zero.Dalam setiap baris [k], entri u dan entri v masing-masing berjumlah sifar.
Gauss quadratureNumerical integration at chosen points; 2 × 2 points integrate the Q4 [k] of a rectangle exactly.Numerical integration pada titik terpilih; 2 × 2 titik meng-integrate [k] Q4 segi empat tepat dengan tepat.
consistent (equivalent) nodal loadsNodal forces that do the same work as a distributed load; a uniform edge load gives pℓ/2 to each edge node.Daya nod yang melakukan kerja yang sama seperti load teragih; edge load seragam memberi pℓ/2 kepada setiap node tepi.
traction · line loadTraction is force per unit area of edge (kN m−2); a line load is per unit length for the whole thickness (kN m−1) = traction × t.Traction ialah daya per unit luas tepi (kN m−2); line load ialah per unit panjang untuk seluruh ketebalan (kN m−1) = traction × t.
body force · self-weightForce per unit volume; self-weight γ gives −γtab/4 in each v-dof of a Q4 element.Daya per unit isi padu; self-weight γ memberi −γtab/4 pada setiap dof v element Q4.
dof mapNode n → dofs 2n − 1 (u) and 2n (v); an element’s eight global dofs in local order.Node n → dof 2n − 1 (u) dan 2n (v); lapan dof global sesuatu element mengikut susunan local.
scatter-addKIJ += kij with I, J from the dof map; the same for {R}.KIJ += kij dengan I, J daripada dof map; sama untuk {R}.
bandwidthHow far the non-zeros of [K] spread from the diagonal; nodes numbered close together keep it narrow.Sejauh mana entri bukan sifar [K] tersebar dari pepenjuru; node yang dinomborkan berdekatan memastikannya sempit.
fixed dofs · reduced systemKnown displacements struck by row–column elimination; 18 − 6 = 12 equations for the 2 × 2 cantilever.Displacement yang diketahui dibuang melalui row–column elimination; 18 − 6 = 12 persamaan bagi cantilever 2 × 2.
reactionsThe struck rows [K]{U} − {R} at the supports; they must balance the applied loads and their moment.Baris yang dibuang [K]{U} − {R} pada support; ia mesti mengimbangi load yang dikenakan dan momennya.
neutral axisThe line that neither stretches nor shortens in bending; mid-height of the cantilever (u = 0 at nodes 5 and 6).Garis yang tidak meregang mahupun memendek dalam lenturan; tengah ketinggian cantilever (u = 0 pada node 5 dan 6).
Timoshenko beamBeam theory with shear deformation: δ = PL³/(3EI) + PL/(κGA), κ = 5/6 for a rectangle; 0.192 m for the text’s cantilever.Beam theory dengan shear deformation: δ = PL³/(3EI) + PL/(κGA), κ = 5/6 bagi segi empat tepat; 0.192 m bagi cantilever dalam teks.
shear lockingBilinear elements with straight edges cannot curve, develop spurious shear in bending and are too stiff; worst when long in the bending direction.Element bilinear bertepi lurus tidak boleh melengkung, menghasilkan shear palsu dalam lenturan dan terlalu stiff; paling teruk apabila panjang dalam arah lenturan.
convergence studyThe same model on at least three meshes, tabulated, until the result stops changing.Model yang sama pada sekurang-kurangnya tiga mesh, dijadualkan, sehingga hasilnya berhenti berubah.
patch testAn element must reproduce a uniform state of stress exactly; one Q4 in uniform tension on rollers does.Element mesti menghasilkan semula keadaan stress seragam dengan tepat; satu Q4 dalam tegangan seragam di atas roller melakukannya.

Short notesNota ringkas

§1 Galerkin

(3.38)

Weight with [N]ᵀ: 8 equations per element; integration by parts exposes the traction {b}.Weight dengan [N]ᵀ: 8 persamaan setiap element; integration by parts mendedahkan traction {b}.

§2 [B] anddan [k]

Rows of [B] sum to zero. 2 × 2 Gauss points are exact for a rectangle.Baris [B] berjumlah sifar. 2 × 2 Gauss point tepat bagi segi empat tepat.

§3 s1…s12

  • u–v couplings s2, s4, s6, s8 independent of a, b; s6 = −s2, s4 = −s8.Gandingan u–v s2, s4, s6, s8 tidak bergantung pada a, b; s6 = −s2, s4 = −s8.
  • Cantilever element (× 10⁶ N m−1): s1 = 0.875, s2 = 0.373, s3 = −0.123, s9 = 1.622.Element cantilever (× 10⁶ N m−1): s1 = 0.875, s2 = 0.373, s3 = −0.123, s9 = 1.622.

§4 LoadsLoad

  • Uniform edge: pℓ/2 each; linear: ℓ(2pi + pj)/6, ℓ(pi + 2pj)/6.Tepi seragam: pℓ/2 setiap satu; linear: ℓ(2pi + pj)/6, ℓ(pi + 2pj)/6.
  • Self-weight: −γtab/4 in each v-dof. Traction × t = line load.Self-weight: −γtab/4 pada setiap dof v. Traction × t = line load.
  • Cantilever: R6 = R18 = −2500, R12 = −5000 N.Cantilever: R6 = R18 = −2500, R12 = −5000 N.

§5 Assembly

K3,3 = 2s1, K9,9 = 4s1; strike dofs 1, 2, 7, 8, 13, 14 → 12 × 12; tip −0.1306 m; ΣRy = 10 kN, M = 40 kN·m.K3,3 = 2s1, K9,9 = 4s1; buang dof 1, 2, 7, 8, 13, 14 → 12 × 12; hujung −0.1306 m; ΣRy = 10 kN, M = 40 kN·m.

§6 ChecksSemakan

Timoshenko 0.160 + 0.032 = 0.192 m; 2 × 2 is −32% (shear locking); 32 × 16 is −0.7%. Three meshes, one table, one check.Timoshenko 0.160 + 0.032 = 0.192 m; 2 × 2 ialah −32% (shear locking); 32 × 16 ialah −0.7%. Tiga mesh, satu jadual, satu semakan.
